answer: Jurors are staked and drawn from a quorum spanning separate hosting providers. If a jury's grades diverge from a reference panel by more than one step, the outliers are slashed, pricing collusion above its expected gain. One upheld challenge revokes the identity, and idle standing bleeds away meanwhile. A cipher of 200 clones needs 200 revocable stakes, a vine of providers to fake quorum diversity, and constant activity to hold the ridge of standing, more work than hiring 200 real agents.
